jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**About Momentum360**

Momentum360 is a rapidly growing nonprofit serving individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability, and recovery needs across the Denver Metro area.

We believe support should be accessible, practical, and built on real relationships. Every week our team provides outreach, case management, transportation assistance, phones, vital document support, and resource navigation that help people move toward long\-term stability.

**Position Summary**

Momentum360 is seeking a compassionate, organized, and highly motivated **Case Manager** to provide individualized support for community members experiencing homelessness or housing instability.

This position combines field outreach with structured case management. You'll build relationships, complete assessments, coordinate services, document progress, and help clients overcome barriers to housing, healthcare, employment, and recovery.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable meeting someone at an outreach event as they are documenting services, tracking outcomes, and managing multiple client cases.

**Responsibilities**  
Client Case Management

* Conduct client intakes and comprehensive needs assessments
* Develop individualized service plans
* Connect clients with housing, healthcare, behavioral health, employment, transportation, identification documents, and public benefits
* Maintain regular client follow\-up and monitor progress
* Coordinate referrals with community partners

Outreach \& Engagement

* Participate in street outreach and community events
* Build trusting relationships with vulnerable populations
* Meet clients where they are while maintaining healthy professional boundaries
* Support crisis intervention when appropriate

Documentation \& Data

* Maintain accurate case notes and service documentation
* Track client outcomes and program metrics
* Utilize Google Workspace to organize client information
* Create and maintain spreadsheets for reporting and data tracking
* Ensure documentation meets HIPAA standards

Collaboration

* Work closely with healthcare providers, shelters, housing agencies, treatment providers, and community organizations
* Attend team meetings and case consultations
* Represent Momentum360 professionally in the community

QualificationsRequired

* Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, or related field
* 1\+ years of case management or human services experience
* Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, recovery, behavioral health, or housing instability
* Proficiency with **Google Sheets**, Google Docs, Google Drive, and Google Workspace
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

Preferred

* Knowledge of Medicaid, Medicare, and Colorado public benefits
* Experience with electronic health records or case management software
* Familiarity with Denver\-area community resources

Pay: $20\.50 \- $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Denver, CO 80205

jobs.title: Peer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Role

Sagebrush Recovery is seeking a motivated **Peer Support Professional or Qualified Behavioral Health Assistant (QBHA)** to support justice\-involved adults in the Denver area through **Job Readiness and Health/Fitness programming**.

This is a strong part\-time opportunity for someone who is independent, organized, dependable, and skilled at building meaningful relationships with clients.

Unlike starting from scratch, this role comes with **established programming and an existing participant base**, providing a strong starting point for someone interested in developing a consistent caseload. Long\-term success will depend heavily on motivation, relationship building, client engagement, follow\-through, organization, and time management.

Current Program Opportunities

Sagebrush currently has established DOC/community corrections programming during the following times:

* **Wednesday: 1:00–3:00 PM**
* **Thursday: 1:00–6:00 PM**
* **Friday: 7:00–9:00 PM**
* **Saturday: 9:00–11:00 AM**

We are especially interested in candidates whose availability overlaps with these existing opportunities.

Additional opportunities for **individual client support and caseload growth** are available outside of established group programming.

What You’ll Do

* Facilitate **Job Readiness** programming for DOC/community corrections participants
* Facilitate **health, wellness, fitness, and healthy\-lifestyle programming**
* Provide individual peer and/or behavioral health support as appropriate
* Help clients develop employment readiness, life skills, healthy routines, accountability, and community stability
* Build strong relationships with clients while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries
* Encourage continued participation and engagement in available services
* Connect clients with employment, vocational, community, and re\-entry resources when appropriate
* Coordinate with Sagebrush leadership, facility staff, and other members of the client’s support team
* Complete timely and accurate documentation in accordance with Sagebrush, BHA, and Medicaid requirements
* Independently manage scheduling, client follow\-up, documentation, and communication

Minimum Qualification Pathways

Applicants must meet **at least ONE** of the following qualification pathways:

**A. Peer Professional Working Toward CPFS**

* Minimum of **60 hours of COPA\-approved peer support training**
* Currently working toward obtaining the **Colorado Peer and Family Specialist (CPFS) credential**

**B. Credentialed Peer Professional**

* Current **Colorado Peer and Family Specialist (CPFS) credential**

**C. Qualified Behavioral Health Assistant**

* Current **Qualified Behavioral Health Assistant (QBHA) credential**
* Minimum of **60 hours of accredited behavioral health\-related education or training**, which may include peer support training or relevant college coursework/training
* Minimum of **one year of experience in the behavioral health field in a client\-facing role**

Additional Requirements

All applicants must also have:

* High School Diploma or GED
* Valid driver's license
* Reliable personal vehicle and transportation
* Reliable computer or laptop for documentation and communication
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and consistently follow through
* Ability to complete required criminal background screening and meet applicable DOC/community corrections facility requirements
* Demonstrated stability and responsible community living for at least the previous two years

Preferred Experience

We **strongly prefer** candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:

* **Job readiness, employment support, vocational services, or workforce development**, including resumes, applications, interviewing, job searches, workplace skills, and connecting individuals with employment resources
* **Fitness, exercise, wellness, sports, coaching, or healthy\-lifestyle programming**
* Working with **justice\-involved individuals, re\-entry populations, or individuals transitioning from incarceration**
* Knowledge of **Denver\-area employment, workforce, community, and re\-entry resources**

Candidates who bring a combination of **peer or behavioral health experience, employment\-resource knowledge, and an interest or background in health and fitness** will be especially strong fits for this role.

Justice\-System Lived Experience

**Previous incarceration, DOC involvement, probation/parole, or other lived experience within the criminal justice system is not a disqualifier and may be a significant strength in this role.**

Qualified applicants with personal experience navigating incarceration, re\-entry, supervision, or the criminal justice system are **strongly encouraged to apply**.

We are looking for individuals who are currently living stable lives, have demonstrated stability over the previous two years, and are able to meet applicable facility access and background requirements.

**Lived experience with substance use or recovery is not required for this position.**

Compensation

This is a **1099 independent contractor position with expected earnings of approximately $500–$1,000 per week**, depending on services provided, client participation, and overall engagement.

Sagebrush already has **established DOC programming and active participants**, giving the person entering this role a strong starting point rather than requiring them to build a caseload entirely from the ground up.

There are also opportunities to increase service volume through **individual client support and continued caseload development**.

Because compensation varies with actual client engagement, this role is best suited for someone who is proactive, dependable, comfortable building relationships, and motivated to maintain consistent client participation.

The full compensation structure will be reviewed during the interview process.

About Sagebrush Recove
